ip_host.title: Link uses a raw IP address
ip_host.why: Real businesses use names, not numbers. Scam pages often hide behind bare IP addresses.
ip_host.tip: Do not enter any details. Ask the sender for the official website name.

at_symbol.title: Hidden '@' trick in the link
at_symbol.why: Everything before '@' is ignored by the browser, so the real destination is what comes after it.
at_symbol.tip: Do not open it. Type the official address yourself.

brand_impersonation.title: Pretends to be a well-known brand
brand_impersonation.why: A famous brand name appears in the link but the site does not belong to that brand.
brand_impersonation.tip: Go to the brand's official app or website directly instead.

free_host.title: Hosted on a free site-builder
free_host.why: Free hosting is cheap to create and throw away, so scammers use it often.
free_host.tip: Be extra careful before logging in or paying.

shortener.title: Shortened link hides the destination
shortener.why: Short links stop you from seeing where you will land.
shortener.tip: Preview the link first or ask for the full address.

risky_tld.title: Cheap, high-abuse domain ending
risky_tld.why: Some endings (.xyz, .top, .tk ...) are heavily used by scam sites.
risky_tld.tip: Treat unknown sites with this ending as untrusted.

lookalike_chars.title: Look-alike characters in the name
lookalike_chars.why: Letters swapped for similar-looking numbers or foreign letters mimic a real name.
lookalike_chars.tip: Check the spelling letter by letter.

many_subdomains.title: Unusually long chain of sub-names
many_subdomains.why: Scammers stack words before the real domain to make it look official.
many_subdomains.tip: Read the link from right to left: the real site is just before the first '/'.

scam_keywords.title: Contains many scam trigger words
scam_keywords.why: Words such as verify, claim, bonus, loan or login together are typical of lures.
scam_keywords.tip: Pause. Ask whether you expected this message.

risky_download.title: Link leads to a risky file
risky_download.why: Installers or archives from a web link can carry malware.
risky_download.tip: Only install apps from your official app store.

no_https.title: Connection is not encrypted
no_https.why: Anything typed on this page can be read on the way.
no_https.tip: Never enter passwords, PINs or card details here.

very_long_url.title: Very long, cluttered link
very_long_url.why: Long links can bury the real destination or tracking/redirect data.
very_long_url.tip: Look at the part just before the first '/'.

redirect_param.title: Link carries another link inside it
redirect_param.why: It may bounce you to a different, hidden site.
redirect_param.tip: Do not trust the first name you see; check the final page address.

odd_port.title: Uses an unusual network port
odd_port.why: Legitimate public sites almost always use the standard ports.

mobile_money_scam.title: Mobile-money scam wording
mobile_money_scam.why: 'Sent by mistake', 'reversal' or 'account blocked' messages are classic mobile-money tricks.
mobile_money_scam.tip: Check your balance in your own app/USSD. Never send money back on request.

loan_scam.title: Fake or advance-fee loan offer
loan_scam.why: Real lenders do not ask for an upfront 'processing' or 'insurance' fee before paying out.
loan_scam.tip: Do not pay any fee to receive a loan. Verify the lender with the regulator.

job_scam.title: Job offer that asks you to pay
job_scam.why: Genuine employers do not charge for visas, medicals or registration.
job_scam.tip: Verify the employer and the recruiter licence before paying anything.

investment_scam.title: Guaranteed or doubled returns
investment_scam.why: No honest investment can guarantee profit or double money quickly.
investment_scam.tip: Walk away. Check the firm is licensed by your financial regulator.

prize_scam.title: 'You won' prize or giveaway
prize_scam.why: Unexpected prizes are bait to collect your details or a 'fee'.
prize_scam.tip: You cannot win a contest you did not enter. Ignore it.

urgency_pressure.title: Pressure to act immediately
urgency_pressure.why: Scammers rush you so you do not think or ask anyone.
urgency_pressure.tip: Slow down. Call the organisation on its official number.

fake_system_alert.title: Fake 'your phone is infected' alert
fake_system_alert.why: Real phones do not show virus warnings inside a web page.
fake_system_alert.tip: Close the tab. Do not install anything it offers.

credential_request.title: Asks for PIN, password or OTP
credential_request.why: No genuine service asks you to share a PIN or one-time code.
credential_request.tip: Never share codes. Contact the provider through its official app.

advance_fee.title: Advance-fee (pay-to-receive) pattern
advance_fee.why: You are asked to pay a small fee to release a large sum or parcel.
advance_fee.tip: Do not pay. The 'big payout' does not exist.

impersonated_authority.title: Impersonates an authority or provider
impersonated_authority.why: Tax, police or telecom names are used to frighten you into acting.
impersonated_authority.tip: Contact the real agency using the number on its official site.

wa_takeover_lure.title: WhatsApp account-takeover lure
wa_takeover_lure.why: Asking for your 6-digit code or a 'linked device' QR scan hands your WhatsApp to the attacker.
wa_takeover_lure.tip: Never share your WhatsApp code or scan QR codes from messages. Enable two-step verification.

wa_fake_app.title: Fake / modified WhatsApp download
wa_fake_app.why: Modded apps (GB, Plus, Gold...) can steal chats and take over the account.
wa_fake_app.tip: Install WhatsApp only from the official store.

wa_deeplink_abuse.title: Suspicious WhatsApp deep link
wa_deeplink_abuse.why: The link pre-fills a message or opens a device-link flow you did not ask for.
wa_deeplink_abuse.tip: Read the pre-filled text before sending anything.

wa_group_promo.title: Group invite tied to money promises
wa_group_promo.why: Investment/giveaway groups are used to recruit victims.
wa_group_promo.tip: Do not join groups that promise income.

exfil_telegram_bot.title: Page sends data to a Telegram bot
exfil_telegram_bot.why: Phishing kits commonly forward typed passwords to a criminal's Telegram bot.
exfil_telegram_bot.tip: Leave the page. Never type anything.

exfil_discord_webhook.title: Page sends data to a Discord webhook
exfil_discord_webhook.why: Stolen details are often posted to a private Discord channel.

exfil_form_service.title: Form data goes to a third-party collector
exfil_form_service.why: Free form collectors are used to harvest details without a real backend.

clipboard_read.title: Page tries to read your clipboard
clipboard_read.why: It could grab copied passwords, addresses or codes.

clipboard_write_hijack.title: Page silently changes what you copy
clipboard_write_hijack.why: Can swap a wallet address or paste a malicious command.
clipboard_write_hijack.tip: Check pasted text before using it.

camera_mic_request.title: Page asks for camera / microphone
camera_mic_request.why: Few pages need this; scam pages use it for ID capture or spying.
camera_mic_request.tip: Deny unless you started a video call.

geolocation_request.title: Page asks for your location
geolocation_request.tip: Deny unless the service needs it.

notification_spam.title: Pushes browser notifications
notification_spam.why: Allowing it lets the site send scam ads to your lock screen.

obfuscated_js.title: Hidden / scrambled script code
obfuscated_js.why: Scrambled code is used to conceal what the page really does.

forced_redirect.title: Page forces a redirect
forced_redirect.why: Automatic jumps send you to ad or scam pages.

popup_loop.title: Endless pop-ups or back-button trap
popup_loop.why: The page tries to keep you trapped and clicking.
popup_loop.tip: Close the tab; clear the site data.

hidden_iframe.title: Invisible frame inside the page
hidden_iframe.why: Hidden frames can load tracking or malicious content.

app_intent_scheme.title: Page tries to open an app / call / SMS
app_intent_scheme.why: It may push you to install an app or send a message.

ws_ip_connection.title: Page opens a live link to a raw IP

credential_form_fake_brand.title: Login box on a page imitating a brand
credential_form_fake_brand.why: A password form plus a big brand name on a site that is not theirs is phishing.

external_form_submit.title: Form sends data to a different website
external_form_submit.why: What you type goes to someone other than the site you see.

password_form_no_https.title: Password asked over an insecure connection

file_critical_ext.title: Executable / installer file
file_critical_ext.why: Such files can run code on your device.
file_critical_ext.tip: Do not open unless you requested it from a trusted source.

file_macro_doc.title: Office document with macros
file_macro_doc.why: Macros are a common way to run malware.

file_archive.title: Compressed archive
file_archive.why: Archives can hide dangerous files inside.

file_double_ext.title: Disguised double extension
file_double_ext.why: 'invoice.pdf.exe' looks like a document but is a program.

file_rtl_override.title: Hidden right-to-left trick in file name
file_rtl_override.why: Reverses part of the name so a program looks like a picture.

file_unknown_ext.title: Unusual or missing file type
file_unknown_ext.why: Unknown types cannot be checked and may be a disguise.

oauth_broad_scope.title: Sign-in asks for very broad access
oauth_broad_scope.why: Reading mail or all files lets an app act as you without your password.
oauth_broad_scope.tip: Deny unless you know the app.

oauth_implicit_token.title: Sign-in hands a token straight to the page
oauth_implicit_token.why: Tokens in the link can be leaked or stolen.

oauth_redirect_mismatch.title: Sign-in returns you to a different site
oauth_redirect_mismatch.why: Your approval is sent to a site unrelated to the app.

device_code_lure.title: 'Enter this code' device-login lure
device_code_lure.why: Attackers ask victims to type a code on a real login page to take over the account.
device_code_lure.tip: Never enter a code you did not generate yourself.

app_perm_bind_accessibility_service.title: Can watch and control your screen
app_perm_bind_accessibility_service.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_bind_accessibility_service.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_bind_device_admin.title: Asks to become a device admin (hard to remove)
app_perm_bind_device_admin.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_bind_device_admin.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_system_alert_window.title: Can draw over other apps (fake login screens)
app_perm_system_alert_window.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_system_alert_window.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_request_install_packages.title: Can install other apps
app_perm_request_install_packages.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_request_install_packages.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_read_sms.title: Can read your SMS (OTP codes)
app_perm_read_sms.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_read_sms.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_receive_sms.title: Intercepts incoming SMS
app_perm_receive_sms.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_receive_sms.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_send_sms.title: Can send SMS (premium charges)
app_perm_send_sms.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_send_sms.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_read_call_log.title: Reads your call history
app_perm_read_call_log.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_read_call_log.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_read_contacts.title: Reads your contacts
app_perm_read_contacts.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_read_contacts.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_manage_external_storage.title: Full access to all files
app_perm_manage_external_storage.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_manage_external_storage.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_bind_notification_listener_serv.title: Reads all notifications (incl. OTPs)
app_perm_bind_notification_listener_serv.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_bind_notification_listener_serv.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_query_all_packages.title: Sees every app you have installed
app_perm_query_all_packages.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_query_all_packages.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_record_audio.title: Can record audio
app_perm_record_audio.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_record_audio.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_bind_vpn_service.title: Can route your traffic through itself
app_perm_bind_vpn_service.why: Powerful permission that banking trojans and stalkerware rely on.
app_perm_bind_vpn_service.tip: Only grant to apps that clearly need it; uninstall if unsure.

app_perm_combo_sms_overlay.title: Reads SMS and draws over apps

app_perm_combo_accessibility_overlay.title: Controls screen and draws over apps
app_perm_combo_accessibility_overlay.why: Lets malware tap buttons and show fake screens.

app_perm_combo_otp_stealer.title: SMS + contacts + internet
app_perm_combo_otp_stealer.why: Can spread by SMS and leak codes.

app_sideloaded.title: Installed outside an official store
app_sideloaded.tip: Reinstall from the official store or remove.

usb_hid_on_cable.title: Charging accessory acts like a keyboard
usb_hid_on_cable.why: Malicious cables inject keystrokes (BadUSB / implant cables).

usb_composite_hid_storage.title: Device is keyboard + storage at once
usb_composite_hid_storage.why: Typical of attack tools disguised as flash drives.

known_bad_host.title: Listed in a phishing database
known_bad_host.why: This exact website address was reported in a public phishing/scam feed.
known_bad_host.tip: Do not open it. Close the page.

new_domain.title: Website registered very recently
new_domain.why: Scam sites are usually only days or weeks old.
new_domain.tip: Be extra careful; do not pay or log in.

bad_tls.title: Security certificate is invalid or missing
bad_tls.why: The padlock check failed, so the site cannot prove who it is.

many_redirects.title: Bounced through several websites
many_redirects.why: Long redirect chains are used to hide the final scam page.
many_redirects.tip: Check the address on the final page.
